about:
Benfield Control Systems Inc., operating as Benfield Electric Supply Co. Inc., is headquartered in Mount Vernon, New York, with a second location in White Plains. The company was founded in 1951 and remains independently owned, having grown from a local electrical supply house into a multi-division distributor serving the New York metropolitan area and beyond.

The business operates across six divisions: Benfield Electric Supply, Benfield Data Comm, Benfield Electric & Elevator Supply, Benfield Control Systems, Lighting, and International. Its 24 service trucks support same-day pickup and next-day delivery across New York City and the Lower Hudson Valley. The company maintains a broad inventory of electrical distribution equipment, elevator wire and rope, building wire, fire alarm cable, conduit, cable tray, lighting, motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, medium-voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, UPS systems, VFDs, and UL 508A-listed industrial control panels. In-house capabilities include value engineering, project management, RCDD-certified data engineers, FOA-certified fiber optic technicians, pre-fabrication, SCADA/CPMS software development, and custom power distribution system design.

Benfield serves industrial enterprises, corporations, original equipment manufacturers, and construction firms. Notable customers include Weill Cornell Medical Center and Lutheran Medical Center, reflecting a strong presence in healthcare. Other markets include commercial construction, data communications, elevator systems, HVAC, power distribution, and renewable energy such as solar, wind, and EV charging infrastructure.

The company emphasizes its independence as a differentiator, stating it is not bound by corporate red tape and can adapt quickly to customer needs. It highlights over 400 years of combined staff experience, recognition on the Westchester 50 list of privately owned businesses, and active community involvement through local hiring and charitable support.
